headline: Fund playback reliability first: songs that will not play or play the wrong tracks, plus the wider playback bugs

recommendations.rationale: PLY-WONTPLAY combines high volume with a high mean severity and is a fixable defect.
recommendations.title: Fix songs not playing or playing wrong tracks

recommendations.rationale: PLY-GENERAL is the second-largest playback issue and includes reports of lost user data.
recommendations.title: Investigate playlist and liked-song loss plus shuffle/autoplay bugs

recommendations.rationale: BIL-PAYWALL has the highest priority score but reflects a monetization policy question and relies heavily on needs_review labels.
recommendations.title: Run a separate paywall messaging review

recommendations.rationale: USA-ADS is high-volume with lower severity, and ACC-LOGIN is severe but small.
recommendations.title: Monitor ads and scope a small login fix
